question: Should Discord Activity support continue from this older draft, move to the broader #65205 branch, or restart as a Canvas-plugin-owned design with fail-closed Activity auth?
rationale: The branch crosses Canvas plugin ownership, Gateway authorization, token transport, root config shape, and overlapping PR strategy, which require maintainer intent before automation can safely repair it.

options.title: Restart on plugin seams
options.body: Rebuild the useful Activity behavior under current Canvas and Discord plugin contracts with fail-closed auth and bounded transport before merge.

options.title: Continue this draft
options.body: Keep this branch as the working vehicle, but require a substantial rebase and security/config redesign before another merge review.

options.title: Consolidate into #65205
options.body: Use the broader open Activity PR as the canonical branch only after it resolves the same security, config, and proof blockers.

recommendation.title: Restart on plugin seams
recommendation.body: Rebuild the useful Activity behavior under current Canvas and Discord plugin contracts with fail-closed auth and bounded transport before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice is the Canvas plugin boundary and Gateway-facing Activity auth model, which recent Canvas plugin history most directly touches.
